req.title: Player payload includes squadNumber
req.statement: The system shall include the squadNumber field on every response body under /players/.

doc.reasoning: The requirement specifies that the squadNumber field must be included in every response body for the /players/{id} endpoint. This test suite ensures that the field is present and correctly handled across different scenarios, including valid, invalid, and boundary cases.

tests.name: test_get_player_by_id_includes_squad_number
preconditions: Player with id '5a9cd988-95e6-54c1-bc34-9aa08acca8d0' exists in the database.
expected: Response body includes 'squadNumber' field with value 1.
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from main import app

client = TestClient(app)
response = client.get('/players/5a9cd988-95e6-54c1-bc34-9aa08acca8d0')
assert response.status_code == 200
assert response.json()['squadNumber'] == 1

tests.name: test_get_player_by_invalid_id
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from main import app

client = TestClient(app)
response = client.get('/players/00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')
assert response.status_code == 404
